metadata.title: AMD's stock has lost nearly a fifth of its value since Intel reported earnings - MarketWatch

content.text:
1 hour ago
AMD's stock has lost nearly a fifth of its value since Intel reported earnings
Shares of AMD have been under pressure across the past two sessions, with investors weighing the implications of Intel's earnings. Broader AI jitters have also rattled chip stocks.
AMD's stock has lost 17.6% since Intel reported its results on Thursday afternoon. Intel's earnings revealed pressure in the PC market as well as an inability to make enough server central processing units that could meet the market's robust demand.
Shares of AMD are up 118% so far this year but down 28% from their 2026 peak achieved last month.
